metadata.purpose: Report on validation and enforcement tools built for repository naming and index management

tools_built.name: validate_naming.py
tools_built.description: Linter that checks all file names against naming conventions from SOP-029. Walks all repo directories, checks files against resource-type-specific regex patterns, and reports violations with severity levels.
features: Checks KB entries (KB-NNNN.md), team logs (TEAM-NNNN.md), SOPs, sources, scripts, coordination modules, tests, templates, and markdown docs
Reports violations with file_path, expected_pattern, actual_name, severity (error/warning)
--fix flag prints suggested mv commands without executing
Exit code 0 if no errors, 1 if errors found
Summary at end: files checked, errors, warnings
tools_built.dependencies: Python stdlib only (argparse, json, os, re, sys, pathlib)

tools_built.name: auto_index.py
tools_built.description: Regenerates all index.json files from source file metadata using the unified SOP-030 schema. Reads YAML frontmatter from .md files and JSON fields from .json files.
features: Scans 6 indexed directories: knowledge-base, teams/sessions, sops, sources, scripts, api-tools
Parses YAML frontmatter from Markdown files (custom parser, no external deps)
Reads JSON metadata from .json source files
Outputs unified SOP-030 schema: version, last_updated, count, entries[]
Removes derived sections (tag_index, categories, by_data_type, etc.)
--dry-run shows what would change without writing
Idempotent: entries sorted by filename, consistent JSON formatting
tools_built.dependencies: Python stdlib only (argparse, json, os, re, sys, pathlib, datetime)

recommendations: Run the kebab-to-snake renames for scripts first (Phase 1 from naming_conventions.json). These are safe, no cross-references depend on script filenames.
Add title field to KB entry YAML frontmatter before running auto_index.py in write mode. Without titles, the regenerated KB index will have empty title fields.
Run auto_index.py (without --dry-run) after fixing the KB frontmatter titles. This will remove derived sections and unify all index schemas, saving an estimated 3,500+ tokens per index read.
Consider adding validate_naming.py to a pre-commit hook to prevent future naming violations.
The SOP files (efficiency_guide.json, etc.) need manual renaming before auto_index.py can properly extract their IDs.

The scripts index drops from 50 to 37 entries because the current index includes cross-references to coordination/ scripts via relative paths (SCR-0029 through SCR-0033). Those should either be moved to the scripts directory or tracked in a separate index.
